title: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B · Ascend 910B3

lede.zh: 这份报告记录 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct 在 4×Ascend 910B3-64G、vLLM-Omni 0.26.0 上的固定语音 prompt 与文本流式服务测试。约 6 秒音频口径下，4 并发的所有观测请求仍满足 RTF < 1；8 并发开始出现尾部越线。
lede.en: This report measures fixed-prompt audio and streaming text serving for Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct on 4× Ascend 910B3-64G with vLLM-Omni 0.26.0. With ~6-second audio, all observed requests remain below RTF 1 at concurrency 4; tail requests cross the limit at concurrency 8.

chips: Thinker TP2 · audio stages 2 replicas each

snapshot.zh: 固定语音生成 · 文本输出 / TTFT · 首音频包延迟
snapshot.en: Fixed audio generation · text output / TTFT · first audio packet latency

stats.zhLabel: 固定 prompt 实时并发

heading.zh: RTF 先于吞吐出现实时边界
heading.en: The real-time boundary appears before the throughput ceiling

intro.zh: 固定约 6 秒语音 prompt 下，RTF 中位数从 C1 的 0.70 升至 C8 的 1.00；C8 最大值为 1.06，已不满足所有请求都实时。文本吞吐在 C1–C16 持续增长，测试范围内尚未饱和。
intro.en: With a fixed ~6-second audio prompt, median RTF rises from 0.70 at C1 to 1.00 at C8; the C8 maximum is 1.06, so not all requests remain real-time. Text throughput continues to grow from C1 through C16 and does not saturate within the tested range.

note.zh: 此报告只使用固定朗读 prompt 的 audio_rtf.py 口径；不同语言、句长、数据集或官方 Omni Bench 采集工具会改变实时路数，不能把别的口径移入此表。
note.en: This report uses only the audio_rtf.py fixed read-aloud prompt profile. Language, utterance length, dataset, or official Omni-bench collection tools can change the real-time boundary; results from those profiles are not mixed into these tables.

heading.zh: C4 所有观测请求实时，C8 开始出现尾部越线
heading.en: All observed requests are real-time at C4; tails cross the limit at C8

intro.zh: 同一约 6 秒语音生成 prompt，在并发 1/2/4/8/16 下测量音频生成时长与 RTF。实时判定按每点观测最大 RTF < 1。
intro.en: The same ~6-second audio-generation prompt was measured at concurrency 1/2/4/8/16. The real-time criterion is maximum observed RTF < 1 at a point.

hint.zh: RTF < 1 表示生成快于音频播放时长。
hint.en: RTF < 1 means generation is faster than audio playback.

notes.zh: C4 最大 RTF 为 0.951，仍低于 1；C8 中位数接近 1，但最大值 1.056 已越线。部署容量需绑定 prompt 和尾部口径，不应仅依据中位数。
notes.en: Maximum RTF at C4 is 0.951, below 1. At C8, the median is near 1 but the maximum reaches 1.056. Capacity should be tied to the prompt and tail criterion, not the median alone.

heading.zh: 首音频包延迟在 C2 到 C4 明显增加
heading.en: First-audio-packet latency increases sharply from C2 to C4

intro.zh: 报告 TTFP P50 与 P95；TTFP 衡量首个音频包到达，不等同于文本首 token TTFT。
intro.en: TTFP P50 and P95 are reported. TTFP measures arrival of the first audio packet and is distinct from text TTFT.

hint.zh: C8 的首包延迟尾部超过 1 秒。
hint.en: The first-packet tail exceeds one second at C8.

notes.zh: C2→C4 的 TTFP P50 从 464 ms 升至 767 ms；RTF P50 同时从 0.692 升至 0.906。按交互体验看，首包延迟的变化比 RTF 中位数更早显著。
notes.en: From C2 to C4, median TTFP rises from 464 ms to 767 ms, while median RTF rises from 0.692 to 0.906. For interactive use, first-packet latency changes become material before the RTF median crosses 1.

heading.zh: 文本吞吐随并发上升，C16 达 36.6 tok/s
heading.en: Text throughput rises with concurrency to 36.6 tok/s at C16

intro.zh: 此矩阵是纯文本流式请求，单独统计输出吞吐、文本 TTFT 与端到端耗时。
intro.en: This is a separate streaming text matrix reporting output throughput, text TTFT, and end-to-end latency.

hint.zh: 已测至 C16，未观察到吞吐峰值。
hint.en: Measured through C16; no throughput peak was observed.

notes.zh: C16 吞吐 36.6 tok/s 是本轮最高测点，不代表硬件饱和峰值。语音输出在 C8 相对纯文本增加约 12.96 s E2E 耗时，适用于本报告的相同请求设置。
notes.en: The C16 throughput of 36.6 tok/s is the highest measured point, not a hardware saturation peak. Audio output adds about 12.96 seconds of E2E time versus text-only at C8 under this report’s request setup.

meta.value: Thinker TP2 · audio stages 2 replicas each

methodIntro.zh: 所有结果取自固定朗读 prompt 测量阶段。语音 RTF 以生成墙钟时间除以生成音频时长；文本指标来自流式文本请求。冷启动阶段不用于稳态性能结论。
methodIntro.en: Results come from the fixed read-aloud prompt phase. Audio RTF is generation wall time divided by generated audio duration; text metrics come from streaming text requests. Cold-start measurements are excluded from steady-state conclusions.

methodNotes.zh: 报告记录的实时上限会随语句长度变化。短句数据集后续另有独立测试，其结果不与本报告约 6 秒 prompt 矩阵合并。
methodNotes.en: The real-time boundary depends on utterance length. A later short-utterance dataset was tested separately and is not merged with this report’s ~6-second prompt matrix.

methodNotes.zh: 测试使用 Thinker TP2、语音阶段副本布局和预热后的服务；硬件节点标签、Kubernetes 资源名、私有地址及本机路径均未写入报告。
methodNotes.en: Testing used Thinker TP2, the reported audio-stage replica layout, and warmed services. Host labels, Kubernetes resource names, private addresses, and local paths are omitted.
